key_insight: High-order discontinuous Galerkin spectral element simulations reproduce reference finite-volume results for a two-dimensional scramjet flow with shock–shock interactions.
engineering_relevance: DGSEM offers an alternative for hypersonic-flow simulation where affordable second-order finite-volume meshes can introduce excessive numerical dissipation.
method: Apply high-order DGSEM with element-local polynomial bases.
Simulate a two-dimensional scramjet configuration with complex hypersonic flow.
Compare results against reference finite-volume solvers.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports agreement with reference finite-volume results, supporting verification of the code implementation.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative error or runtime comparisons, so accuracy and efficiency advantages remain unquantified.
paper_title: Efficient high-order Discontinuous Galerkin simulations of multi-species high-enthalpy flows
